sections.text: The approval step's next job writes exactly these reviews - nothing else: no collection, user, STIG or other review is changed, and no asset but the new ones (NEW ASSET: created with that name and every STIG its checklists matched, then the checklists' answers written as its reviews - 9 of them, counted in its row; the update does not create one that is there by then). Each review is written only if it is still as it was read here (STIG Manager now); one changed since is left, and said. The detail is the checklist's finding details, the comment its comments and where it came from. Not Reviewed in a checklist is never written. MOVE: an asset only in the staging collection, moved to its route's collection first - and only if it is still as it was read; its reviews are written there after it, none if it is not moved. A move keeps the asset's reviews and their history, its STIGs, metadata and labels; a Restricted grant in the staging collection that reached it would lose it - such an asset is not moved, a person decides. ASSIGN: the STIG its checklist matched, assigned to the asset first (stigman_ckl_import_assign_stigs); its reviews after it.
